title: var() Substitution & IACVT Fallback
description: Trace how custom properties pass parse time, inherit, and trigger IACVT.

steps.label: 1. Parse-Time Token Capture
steps.description: Declarations with var() always pass CSS syntax parsing, discarding earlier static fallbacks.
steps.codeHighlight:
background: blue;
background: var(--missing, 12px); /* Passes parse! */

steps.label: 2. Cascade & DOM Inheritance
steps.description: Engine resolves --token values down the DOM tree via standard specificity and inheritance.

steps.label: 3. Computed-Value Substitution (IACVT)
steps.description: Substituting 12px into background fails type-checking; the property becomes IACVT and resets to transparent (not blue).
